## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues, if any.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any checks you could not run. For documentation-only changes, note your review of links, examples, and formatting.

## Compatibility and review notes

Note changes to saved files, autosave, dependencies, or the user interface when relevant. Include screenshots or a small synthetic example if helpful. Remove personal names, email addresses, private diagrams, sensitive information, and local filesystem paths from attachments.

## Merge authorization

CI results are verification evidence. Merging requires separate, explicit authorization from the repository owner or the owner's locally operated Codex. Leave merging to that authorized actor.
